description: Foundations of democratic governance, civil service conduct rules, constitutional values, public integrity, and conflict of interest management.
learning_objectives:
1. Understand civil service values and constitutional framework.
2. Master conflict-of-interest identification and mitigation.
3. Uphold transparency, empathy, and accountability in everyday administration.

description: Architecture of India Stack (Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker, e-Office), data privacy regulations, cybersecurity best practices, and AI applications in public service delivery.
learning_objectives:
1. Understand India Stack architecture and API frameworks.
2. Apply data privacy and cyber hygiene standards.
3. Identify opportunities for AI and workflow automation in public service.

description: Mastery of Central Secretariat Manual of Office Procedure (CSMOP), precision noting, cabinet note preparation, legislative drafting basics, and answering Parliamentary Questions (Starred/Unstarred).
learning_objectives:
1. Draft structured, persuasive, and legally sound office notes.
2. Prepare comprehensive replies to Parliament questions and Standing Committees.
3. Formulate cabinet summaries with inter-ministerial consensus.

description: Evidence-based policymaking, statistical analysis, root-cause diagnostics, stakeholder consensus building, and crisis management frameworks.
learning_objectives:
1. Apply data-driven decision trees to policy problems.
2. Evaluate multi-stakeholder trade-offs with risk matrices.
3. Manage crisis decision protocols with agility and accountability.

description: Deep dive into GFR 2017, GeM 4.0 operations, budgeting, expenditure control, audit compliance, contract management, and vigilance guidelines.
learning_objectives:
1. Master GFR 2017 provisions and financial delegations.
2. Execute end-to-end procurement on GeM (L1, Custom Bids, RA).
3. Ensure seamless audit compliance and vigilance clearance.

description: Mission-mode project lifecycle, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Gantt charts, vendor SLA management, milestone monitoring dashboards, and public scheme evaluation.
learning_objectives:
1. Design project charters and milestone schedules for government schemes.
2. Enforce vendor accountability and SLA performance.
3. Manage project risk registers and contingency plans.
